pages.label: Course: Everyday Conversation
pages.html:
Course 01 · A2–B1 · 8 weeks

Everyday
Conversation.

Speak up at work, in shops and cafés. Three live sessions a week and daily voice tasks.

Enrol · RM 390Free first lesson

Syllabus
Weeks 1–2 · Introductions & small talk

Greetings, describing your day, asking follow-up questions.

Weeks 3–4 · Shops, cafés and transport

Ordering, asking prices, solving problems politely.

Weeks 5–6 · At work

Stand-ups, asking for help, short updates.

Weeks 7–8 · Phone calls & plans

Booking, rescheduling, making and changing plans.

pages.label: FAQ
pages.html:
Home/FAQ

FAQ

Do I need to be at a certain level?

Start with the level check. Every course lists the level it suits.

What time zones do you cover?

Live sessions run from 06:00 to 23:00 in UTC+8, UTC+1 and UTC-5.

Can I switch tutors?

Yes, at any time, without asking why.
